assessment_scope: Integrated NEXARA software components on one computer, including two separate processes with independent SQLite databases, using synthetic non-sensitive data and simulated link conditions.
position: TRL 4 candidate: integrated software subsystem validated in a laboratory; independent evaluation pending

checks.criterion: Integrated software verified by automated tests
Three formats mapped into the same canonical system and exchanged without loss of meaning or provenance
Integrated nodes process locally during outage and converge after reconnection
Laboratory cases preserve domain/service values and replay is repeatable
Bounded internal format checks pass without claiming external certification
Two process-isolated nodes preserve offline state through restart and reconcile without loss of conflicts or provenance

limitations: Process-isolated nodes are exercised on one computer over local JSON pipes; physical-node and actual network tests remain future work.
DDIL link conditions are simulated; this is not a representative military RF hardware test.
NIEM 6 mapping is experimental; MTF-XML, NIEM and NCDF external conformance are not established.
No DND/CAF operational validation, security accreditation, or independent TRL assessment is claimed.
separate_challenge_gaps: IDEAS-E03: authoritative sponsor-selected standards profiles and validation are outstanding.
IDEAS-E05: external simulation or wargaming integration remains outstanding.
